final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(b.spent / b.amount) AS event_average FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), type_averages AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_average) AS type_average FROM event_averages GROUP BY type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS overall_average FROM type_averages) SELECT t.type, t.type_average, t.type_average / o.overall_average FROM type_averages AS t JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
